_readme: No keys or RPC URLs with API keys belong in this file. 'verified' notes say how each address was checked (rpc = on-chain read on 2026-10-01; web = cited page; repo = repo test config). Omitted keys are unknown and read as address(0) by the deploy scripts; see 'todo'.
name: robinhood

weth.verified: rpc: symbol WETH, 18 dec; also WETH9() of SwapRouter02; docs https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts/

usdg.verified: rpc: name 'Global Dollar', symbol USDG, 6 dec; docs https://docs.robinhood.com/chain/contracts/

release.chainlinkStaleRateThresholdNote: All registered feeds (USDG/USD, ETH/USD) have an 86400s heartbeat. The USDG/USD feed was observed updating with a 86430s gap (heartbeat + 30s), so a threshold equal to the heartbeat would revert valuation: 2 x 86400 = 172800s tolerates one fully missed heartbeat. Only non-equity feeds are registered, so 24/5 equity staleness does not apply. Trade-off: a depegged/halted stablecoin feed can be up to 48h stale before valuation reverts; the 0.5% deviation trigger bounds normal drift.

gasRelay.verified: no GSN on Robinhood Chain known; gas relay disabled

ethUsdAggregator.verified: rpc: description 'ETH / USD', 8 dec, fresh answer; heartbeat 86400s per Chainlink directory JSON; observed max gap over last 30 rounds 32560s

primitives.verified: rpc: description 'USDG / USD', 8 dec, fresh answer; heartbeat 86400s per Chainlink directory JSON; observed max gap over last 30 rounds 86430s

uniswapV3SwapRouter02.verified: rpc: code present (24497 bytes), factory()/WETH9() read, selector b858183f present and c04b8d59 absent. Address per Uniswap docs https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v3/deployments/v3-robinhood-chain-deployments

paraSwapAugustusV6.verified: rpc: 24562 bytes of code; address per Velora docs

features.phaseNote: Phase 1 = vault creation + deposit/redeem only, USDG denomination. Phase 2 = ParaSwap v6 behind AllowedAdapters. Phase 3 = patched UniswapV3Adapter.

No L2 sequencer uptime feed exists for Robinhood Chain.
